text: {"reply":"A brake warning light with grinding is serious, so please don't drive the car. I'm sorry, my colleague's earlier advice to drive to Vaughan was wrong. Where is the car right now?","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer reports grinding from the front right and a brake warning light (brake with exclamation mark) on a 2021 Meridian Arbor, about 54,000 km. The customer is not verified yet and the location is unknown. Please arrange a tow and a brake inspection, and handle the warranty question after the inspection.
